name: Landmark EKF-SLAM
approach: Joint Gaussian robot and landmark estimation
frontEnd: Known marker IDs and relative range/bearing observations
backEnd: EKF prediction, landmark augmentation and innovation-gated correction
outputs: Body trajectories, landmark map and joint covariance
publication: Educational implementation using the standard EKF-SLAM formulation

name: DOOR-SLAM
frontEnd: Visual odometry, appearance matching and geometric verification
backEnd: Pairwise consistency filtering and distributed optimization
outputs: Corrected keyframe poses and pose graphs
publication: DOOR-SLAM: Distributed, Online, and Outlier Resilient SLAM for Robotic Teams, RA-L 2020
authors: P.-Y. Lajoie, B. Ramtoula, Y. Chang, L. Carlone, G. Beltrame

name: Kimera-Multi
approach: Metric-semantic mapping and robust distributed optimization
frontEnd: Visual-inertial odometry and distributed place recognition
backEnd: Robust distributed pose graphs and local mesh deformation
outputs: Corrected trajectories, graphs and metric-semantic meshes when semantic inputs are supplied
publication: Kimera-Multi: a System for Distributed Multi-Robot Metric-Semantic SLAM, ICRA 2021
authors: Y. Chang, Y. Tian, J. P. How, L. Carlone

name: D²SLAM
approach: Collaborative visual-inertial estimation and global pose graphs
frontEnd: D2VINS with visual tracking and learned place descriptors
publication: D²SLAM: Decentralized and Distributed Collaborative Visual-inertial SLAM System for Aerial Swarm, TRO 2024
authors: H. Xu, P. Liu, X. Chen, S. Shen

name: Swarm-SLAM
approach: Sparse collaborative constraints and prioritized loop detection
frontEnd: Local odometry and bandwidth-aware inter-robot matching
outputs: Corrected robot trajectories and graph constraints
publication: Swarm-SLAM: Sparse Decentralized Collaborative SLAM Framework for Multi-Robot Systems, RA-L 2024

name: ORB-SLAM2
frontEnd: ORB features, matching, tracking and local mapping
publication: ORB-SLAM2: an Open-Source SLAM System for Monocular, Stereo and RGB-D Cameras, TRO 2017

name: RTAB-Map
backEnd: Graph optimization with configurable mapping outputs
outputs: Trajectories, occupancy grids, point clouds and databases depending on configuration
publication: RTAB-Map as an Open-Source Lidar and Visual SLAM Library for Large-Scale and Long-Term Online Operation, JFR 2019
